query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.nodepool-*
| WHERE ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscale == true
| KEEP ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.name, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.min_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.max_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.current_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscaling.scale_down_utilization_threshold, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscaling.scale_down_unneeded_time_seconds
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.nodepool-*
| WHERE ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscale == true
| KEEP ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.name, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.min_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.max_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.current_nodes, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscaling.scale_down_utilization_threshold, ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.autoscaling.scale_down_unneeded_time_seconds
| LIMIT 100

| STATS `Node Currency Ratio (%)` = AVG(ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.up_to_date_nodes) / AVG(ovh.kubernetes.nodepool.current_nodes) * 100 BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time Bucket`
